entries.title: Quitting while a crewmate works no longer sets its work aside
entries.body: Quitting the app three times while a crewmate was working set its message aside. Now each restart gives the crewmate its message again and says the app restarted, so it checks what it already did before repeating a step.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the crewmate carries on after a restart instead of its message being set aside.
